<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Exhibit 10.1</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: #102A43"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>MASTER
SALES AGREEMENT</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: #102A43"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 12pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">This Master Sales Agreement (this
<B>&ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;</B>) is entered into as of December 16, 2025 (the <B>&ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo;</B>), by and among:</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">a)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Manufacturing
                                            360, LLC, </B>a Washington limited liability company (&ldquo;Seller&rdquo;), in its capacity
                                            as the sole record and beneficial owner of one (1) share of the Special 2020 Series A Preferred
                                            Stock of Renewal Fuels, Inc.;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">b)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Earth
                                            Sciences Fund I LLC, </B>a Texas limited liability company (&ldquo;Buyer&rdquo; or &ldquo;ESF&rdquo;);
                                            and</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">c)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>RH2
                                            Equity Partners, LP</B>, a Delaware limited partnership (the <B>&ldquo;</B>Consultant&rdquo;
                                            or &ldquo;RH2&rdquo;, and, together with Seller and Buyer, each a &ldquo;Party&rdquo; and
                                            collectively the &ldquo;Parties&rdquo;).</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">This
Agreement sets forth the terms and conditions governing the transfer of control of Renewal Fuels, Inc. through the sale of the Special
2020 Series A Preferred Share, the simultaneous share exchange transaction involving Kepler Fusion Technologies Inc., and the engagement
of RH2 to provide transitional and compliance-related services in connection with the Transaction and post-closing integration.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">RECITALS</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">Seller is the sole record and beneficial owner of one (1) share of the Special 2020 Series A Preferred
Stock of Renewal Fuels, Inc., a Delaware corporation traded on OTC Markets under symbol RNWF (&ldquo;RNWF&rdquo;), which one (1) share
(the &ldquo;Control Share&rdquo;) carries voting rights equal to sixty percent (60%) of the total voting power of all outstanding voting
securities of RNWF, voting together with the common stock as a single class on all matters submitted to shareholders;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">Buyer desires to acquire from Seller, and Seller desires to transfer to Buyer, all of Seller&rsquo;s
right, title, and interest in and to the Control Share, free and clear of all liens, claims, pledges, encumbrances, and restrictions
other than those arising under applicable securities laws, pursuant to the terms of this Agreement and the related Stock Transfer Agreement;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">immediately upon the transfer of the Control Share to Buyer, RNWF, as the surviving public corporation
under Buyer&rsquo;s voting control, shall enter into a Share Exchange Agreement with Kepler Fusion Technologies Inc. (&ldquo;Kepler&rdquo;),
pursuant to which RNWF shall acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares or other equity interests of Kepler in a reverse-merger
share exchange transaction (the &ldquo;Share Exchange&rdquo;);</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">the Parties acknowledge and agree that the transfer of the Control Share to Buyer and the consummation
of the Share Exchange with Kepler are interdependent, shall occur simultaneously, and neither transaction shall close unless both transactions
close at the same time;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">Consultant shall provide transitional administrative, compliance, disclosure, and capital-markets support
to RNWF in connection with the Transaction and post-closing integration pursuant to a separate Consulting Agreement to be executed concurrently
herewith;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 12pt; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">the Parties desire to set forth in this Agreement the terms, conditions, covenants, obligations, and
closing deliverables pertaining to the transfer of control of RNWF, the simultaneous Share Exchange with Kepler, and the execution and
delivery of all related definitive agreements and supporting instruments; and</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">WHEREAS,
<FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">the Parties enter into this Agreement in reliance upon the representations, warranties, disclosures,
and covenants contained herein and intend for this Agreement to govern the overall structure, coordination, and closing mechanics of
the Transaction.</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>1.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">DEFINITIONS</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 12pt; margin-right: 0; margin-left: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As
used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined
herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Transaction Agreements, as applicable.</FONT></P>

                                            Business&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the equity interests, operations,
                                            contracts, assets, intellectual property, rights, and business activities of Kepler Fusion
                                            Technologies Inc. to be acquired by RNWF pursuant to the Share Exchange Agreement.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means this Master Sales Agreement, together with all exhibits,
                                            schedules, and any other documents incorporated by reference herein.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: black">1.3.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;Buyer&rdquo;
                                            <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">or</FONT> &ldquo;ESF&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means
                                            Earth Sciences Fund I LLC, a Texas limited liability company, and its permitted successors
                                            and assigns.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: black">1.4.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;Closing&rdquo;
                                            <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the consummation of the Transaction, including (a)
                                            the transfer of the Control Share to Buyer, (b) the execution and delivery of the Share Exchange
                                            Agreement, and (c) the simultaneous acquisition by RNWF of all issued and outstanding shares
                                            or equity interests of Kepler, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions precedent
                                            set forth herein.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: black">1.5.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;Closing
                                            Date&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the date on which the Closing occurs.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: black">1.6.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;Consultant&rdquo;
                                            <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">or</FONT> &ldquo;RH2&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means
                                            RH2 Equity Partners, LP, a Delaware limited partnership, together with its authorized officers,
                                            agents, and affiliates.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: black">1.7.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;Consulting
                                            Agreement&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the agreement between Consultant
                                            and RNWF executed concurrently with this Agreement, pursuant to which Consultant shall provide
                                            transitional, administrative, compliance, and disclosure services.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            Share&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the one (1) share of Special 2020 Series
                                            A Preferred Stock of RNWF held by Seller, which carries voting rights equal to sixty percent
                                            (60%) of the total voting power of all outstanding voting securities of RNWF, voting together
                                            with the common stock as a single class on all matters.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            Agreements&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means collectively this Agreement, the
                                            Stock Transfer Agreement, the Share Exchange Agreement, the Consulting Agreement, and all
                                            other agreements, instruments, exhibits, schedules, certificates, and closing deliverables
                                            executed in connection with the Transaction.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            Schedules&rdquo; <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the schedules delivered by a Party
                                            to the other Parties in connection with this Agreement, setting forth exceptions to that
                                            Party&rsquo;s representations, warranties, or other matters required to be disclosed hereunder.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            Transfer Agreement.&rdquo;</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            the definitive agreement between RNWF and Kepler pursuant to which RNWF shall acquire one
                                            hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding equity of Kepler.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            concurrently with this Agreement.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            <FONT STYLE="font-weight: normal">means the collective transactions contemplated by the Definitive
                                            Agreements, including (a) the transfer of the Control Share to Buyer, (b) the Share Exchange

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>2.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">PURCHASE
                                            AND SALE OF CONTROL SHARE</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">2.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">Transfer
                                            of Control Share. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Stock Transfer
                                            Agreement, Seller shall sell, assign, transfer, and deliver to Buyer, and Buyer shall purchase
                                            from Seller, all of Seller&rsquo;s right, title, and interest in and to the Control Share,
                                            free and clear of all liens, pledges, encumbrances, security interests, claims, options,
                                            or restrictions of any kind other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities laws.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">2.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">Voting
                                            Rights. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Control Share constitutes one share of
                                            the Special 2020 Series A Preferred Stock of RNWF, which carries voting rights equal to sixty
                                            percent of the total voting power of all outstanding voting securities of RNWF, voting together
                                            with the common stock as a single class on all matters. Upon consummation of the transfer
                                            of the Control Share, Buyer shall possess and exercise full voting control of RNWF in accordance
                                            with such rights.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            of Transfer. The transfer of the Control Share shall be effected at Closing by the delivery
                                            to Buyer or Buyer&rsquo;s designee of a duly executed and medallion guaranteed stock power
                                            endorsed by Seller, any other transfer instruments reasonably required by RNWF or its transfer
                                            agent to record Buyer as the sole record and beneficial owner of the Control Share, and evidence
                                            reasonably satisfactory to Buyer confirming that all corporate records, books, and ledgers
                                            of RNWF reflect Buyer as the holder of the Control Share as of the Closing Date.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            Assumed Liabilities. Buyer is purchasing only the Control Share. Buyer is not assuming any
                                            liabilities, debts, obligations, agreements, contracts, or responsibilities of Seller of
                                            any kind, whether fixed, contingent, known, unknown, asserted, or unasserted, except as expressly
                                            set forth in this Agreement or any other Definitive Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            Is Transaction. Buyer acknowledges that the Control Share is being transferred on an as is,
                                            where is basis, without any express or implied representation or warranty of any kind by
                                            Seller, except for the representations expressly set forth in this Agreement and the Stock
                                            Transfer Agreement. Buyer acknowledges that it has conducted its own investigation into RNWF
                                            and has not relied on any representation or warranty of Seller or any other Person except
                                            as expressly provided herein.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            Closing Condition. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the transfer of the Control Share
                                            shall not occur unless the Share Exchange between RNWF and Kepler closes simultaneously,
                                            and the Share Exchange shall not occur unless the transfer of the Control Share closes simultaneously.
                                            Neither Party shall be obligated to close unless both components of the Transaction close
                                            at the same time.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

or control person of RNWF unless separately agreed in writing</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Further
                                            Assurances</U>. Each Party shall execute and deliver such additional documents and shall
                                            take such further actions as may be reasonably necessary or appropriate to carry out the
                                            provisions of this Agreement and the other Transaction Agreements and to consummate the Transaction.
                                            Each Party shall cooperate in good faith with the other Parties to complete all filings,
                                            notices, and approvals required for the Transaction.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Conduct
                                            of Business Prior to Closing</U>. Between the Effective Date and the Closing Date, each Party
                                            shall use commercially reasonable efforts to preserve its business, assets, and goodwill
                                            and shall not take any action that would reasonably be expected to materially impair or delay
                                            its ability to consummate the Transaction or perform its obligations under this Agreement.
                                            RNWF and Kepler shall not enter into any material transaction outside the ordinary course
                                            of business without the prior written consent of Buyer except as required to complete the
                                            Transaction.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.3.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Confidentiality</U>.
                                            Each Party shall maintain in strict confidence all confidential or non public information
                                            received from the other Parties in connection with the negotiation and performance of this
                                            Agreement. No Party shall disclose such information except to its legal, financial, or accounting
                                            advisors or as required by applicable law or stock market rules. Each Party shall ensure
                                            that any such advisors comply with this confidentiality covenant.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.4.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Required
                                            Filings and Regulatory Matters</U>. RNWF shall make all filings and submissions required
                                            by applicable law or stock market rules to effect the Change of Control and the Share Exchange
                                            including any updates to its OTC Markets profile and any required state or federal corporate
                                            filings. Buyer shall reasonably cooperate with RNWF in preparing and providing any information
                                            required for such filings or submissions.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.5.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Public
                                            Announcements</U>. No Party shall issue any press release or public announcement regarding
                                            this Agreement or the Transaction without the prior written consent of the other Parties
                                            except where required by applicable law. If disclosure is required by law, the disclosing
                                            Party shall provide the other Parties with a reasonable opportunity to review and comment
                                            on the proposed disclosure before it is made.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.6.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Access
                                            to Books and Records</U>. Prior to the Closing, RNWF and Kepler shall provide Buyer with
                                            reasonable access during normal business hours to their books, records, contracts, and financial
                                            information for the purpose of completing Buyer&rsquo;s confirmatory review and preparing
                                            for the Share Exchange. Buyer shall maintain the confidentiality of all such information
                                            in accordance with Section 8.3.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.7.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Restriction
                                            on Transfer of Control Share</U>. Seller shall not transfer, pledge, encumber, or otherwise
                                            dispose of the Control Share between the Effective Date and the Closing Date except to Buyer
                                            pursuant to this Agreement. Seller shall immediately notify Buyer of any attempted or threatened
                                            adverse claim affecting the Control Share.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.8.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Litigation
                                            Cooperation</U>. RNWF shall continue to pursue the litigation relating to the Costello Shares
                                            and shall cooperate in good faith with Buyer in providing updates on the status of such litigation.
                                            Buyer acknowledges that the successful cancellation of the Costello Shares is not a condition
                                            to Closing and agrees that the Transaction shall proceed regardless of the timing or outcome
                                            of the litigation.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.9.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Operation
                                            of RNWF Post Closing</U>. Following the Closing, RNWF shall take such corporate actions as
                                            may be reasonably necessary to give effect to the Transaction including implementing the
                                            Share Exchange, updating corporate governance, and integrating the Acquired Business. RNWF
                                            shall cooperate with Consultant in carrying out the transitional and extended services described
                                            in the Consulting Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">8.10.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>No
                                            Solicitation of Competing Transactions</U>. From the Effective Date until the earlier of
                                            Closing or termination of this Agreement, neither RNWF nor Seller shall solicit, negotiate,
                                            or enter into any agreement relating to any competing sale of control, equity sale, merger,
                                            or similar transaction with any other party. RNWF shall promptly notify Buyer of any unsolicited
                                            inquiry or proposal received.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Each Party acknowledges and agrees that,
as an essential component of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, the allocation of risk set forth in this Section is fundamental
to the Parties&rsquo; decision to enter into and consummate the Transaction. Accordingly, the indemnification obligations described in
this Section shall apply following the Closing and, where expressly stated, prior to the Closing, and shall govern the rights and responsibilities
of the Parties with respect to any losses, liabilities, claims, damages, costs, or expenses arising out of or relating to the matters
specified herein. The indemnification obligations in this Section shall operate in addition to, and not in limitation of, any rights
or remedies available at law, in equity, or under any other Transaction Agreement, except to the extent expressly limited herein.</FONT></P>

the instructions or actions of RNWF</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><FONT STYLE="display: inline-block; width: 0.5in; float: left; white-space:nowrap">c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
</FONT>any claim asserted by a third-party alleging Consultant&rsquo;s violation of a confidentiality or non-disclosure obligation</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">9.5.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Indemnification
                                            by Kepler</U>. Kepler shall indemnify and hold harmless RNWF and Buyer and their respective
                                            officers, directors, managers, members, partners, agents, and representatives from and against
                                            any and all losses, liabilities, claims, damages, costs, and expenses including reasonable
                                            attorneys fees arising out of or relating to:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><FONT STYLE="display: inline-block; width: 0.5in; float: left; white-space:nowrap">a)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
</FONT>any breach by Kepler of any representation, warranty, covenant, or obligation under the Share Exchange Agreement or any other
Transaction Agreement</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><FONT STYLE="display: inline-block; width: 0.5in; float: left; white-space:nowrap">b)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
</FONT>any liability of Kepler arising from events occurring prior to the Closing other than liabilities disclosed in the Share Exchange
Agreement</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 2pt 0 0 0.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><FONT STYLE="display: inline-block; width: 0.5in; float: left; white-space:nowrap">c)</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
</FONT>any claim that Kepler lacks proper title to the equity interests to be exchanged or that such equity interests are subject to
an undisclosed lien, claim, or encumbrance</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">9.6.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Claims
                                            Procedure</U>. A Party seeking indemnification under this Section shall provide the indemnifying
                                            Party with prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnification is sought. Failure
                                            to provide such notice shall not relieve the indemnifying Party of its obligations except
                                            to the extent that the failure materially prejudices the indemnifying Party&rsquo;s ability
                                            to defend the claim. The indemnifying Party shall have the right to assume the defense of
                                            any claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, provided that the
                                            indemnified Party may participate in such defense at its own expense. No settlement of any
                                            claim shall be made without the prior written consent of the indemnified Party if such settlement
                                            imposes any obligation or admission of liability on the indemnified Party.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">9.7.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Limitations</U>.
                                            No Party shall be liable under this Section for any consequential, special, incidental, exemplary,
                                            or punitive damages except to the extent such damages are awarded to a third party in a claim
                                            covered by this Section. The indemnification obligations under this Section shall survive
                                            the Closing for the period set forth in the applicable Transaction Agreements or, if no period
                                            is specified, for a period of two years following the Closing Date.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

</FONT>when delivered personally</FONT></P>

shall be sent to the addresses set forth in the signature pages or to such other address as a Party may designate by written notice to
the other Parties.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The following exhibits and schedules are
attached to this Agreement and incorporated herein:<BR>
<BR></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit A &ndash; Stock Transfer Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement between Seller and Buyer relating
to the transfer of the Control Share.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit B &ndash; Share Exchange Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement between RNWF and Kepler relating
to the exchange of all issued and outstanding equity of Kepler.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit C &ndash; Consulting and Advisory
Services Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement between RNWF and Consultant relating
to transitional and extended advisory services.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit D &ndash; Pinnacle Note Settlement,
Exchange and Assignment Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement governing the settlement, exchange,
and assignment of the Pinnacle Notes held by Consultant, including issuance of shares and assignment of remaining value to Buyer&rsquo;s
designated assignees.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit E &ndash; CMB Note Settlement,
Exchange and Assignment Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement governing the settlement, exchange,
and assignment of the CMB Notes held by Consultant, including issuance of shares and assignment of remaining value to Buyer&rsquo;s designated
assignees.<BR>
<BR>
<B>Exhibit F &ndash; Settlement and Exchange Designated Agreement</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agreement governing the settlement, exchange,
and assignment of the Pinnacle and CMB Notes held by Consultants, including issuance of shares and assignment of remaining value to Buyer&rsquo;s
designated assignees.<BR>
<BR></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Schedule 2 &ndash; RNWF Capitalization
Table</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Delivered by RNWF at Closing and updated
as of the Closing Date.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Schedule 3 &ndash; Kepler Organizational
Documents</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Including formation documents, good standing,
contracts, IP lists, and corporate records.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Schedule 4 &ndash; Seller Transfer Documents</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Including the endorsed stock power and any
instruments required for transfer of the Control Share.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Schedule 5 &ndash; Buyer Corporate Approvals</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Buyer&rsquo;s resolutions and consents authorizing
entry into the Transaction.</FONT></P>
